text:
lena: Heads-up: proposal — add a 'semaphore' safety on high-impact runtime flags to cap concurrent activations per-cohort. Prevent rapid mass rollouts that spike quota/routing.

josh: Can you sketch how it behaves? cap is tokens/sec or activations/sec?

lena: Activations/sec per flag per cohort, with a small burst allowance and exponential backoff on violations. Default cap 10/s, burst 50, backoff factor 2.

ravi: @lena how do we handle queued requests? Do we fail-fast or enqueue?

lena: Fail-fast with a short `Retry-After` header for callers. Console shows 'paused by safety' and owner can override for a bounded window.

maya: UX note: need a clear, discoverable signal in Console — show semaphore state, current qps, last triggered reason, and a link to telemetry. Also disable 'force enable' unless owner + 2FA + a justification note.

devon: Agree on telemetry. We'll need canary-aligned metrics and SLIs: `config.activation_rate`, `config.blocked_count`, `config.override_count`. What alert thresholds should we start with?

cara: From SRE: prefer fail-open only for low-risk flags; for infra-critical flags default to fail-closed. Suggest backoff schedule: 10s, 30s, 2m, 10m. Add an emergency 'safemode' bypass for the infra oncall team.

josh: Implementation notes: routing layer will consult the config service pre-eval. We have a fast local cache; I'd prefer the semaphore check as a tiny token-bucket in the runtime to avoid extra RPCs.

lena: Here's a sample dry-run flag config snippet — feedback pls:

```json
{
  "flag": "enable_new_preflight",
  "semaphore": {
    "cap_per_cohort": 10,
    "burst": 50,
    "backoff_seconds": [10, 30, 120, 600],
    "mode": "fail-fast",
    "owners": ["devon", "lena"]
  }
}
```

configbot: Preflight results: schema OK. Warnings: owners list not using team alias; telemetry hook 'blocked_count' missing. See /preflight/4417770000 for details.

ravi: We should auto-insert telemetry scaffolding for any semaphore-enabled flag or fail the preflight.

maya: Console copy idea: when a flag is throttled, surface a short explanation + recommended next steps + a one-click link to open a dry-run session.

josh: :thumbsup: on runtime token-bucket. Need a perf benchmark — rough estimate: +1% p95 overhead at 10k rps for a well-optimized implementation.

lena: I'll draft an RFC and a tiny PoC. Action items: lena -> write RFC & PoC; josh -> benchmark token-bucket perf; devon -> propose alert thresholds and SLIs; cara -> safemode runbook + playbook; maya -> console mocks and copy. Ping me if blocked.

devon: Ack, will define thresholds today.

cara: Ok, I'll draft safemode steps.

josh: On it, starting perf harness.

ravi: +1 to auto-telemetry.

lena: thx everyone :rocket:
